output.expected_benefit: Reduce the time taken to draft press releases by half, saving 1.5 hours per draft.
requirements: Develop a system that can read and understand internal reports and briefing notes.
Automate the initial drafting of press releases based on the content of the reports and briefing notes.
Ensure the system can handle a variety of report and briefing note formats.
Integrate with existing communication tools and workflows.
Provide a user-friendly interface for staff to review and edit drafts.
Ensure all drafts are reviewed and approved by a communications officer before publication.
